source: User-supplied resources/lyrics-spelling/點不著的番仔火-江蕙

blocks.text: 突然間有一陣冷風吹來
blocks.spelling: hut-liân kian ū tsi̍t tsūn líng-hong tshue lâi

blocks.text: 才知影原來思念猶原　捲底心肝內
blocks.spelling: tsiah tsai-iánn guân-lâi su-liām iu-guân kńg té sim-kuann-lāi

blocks.text: 月台邊情人雙雙對對　目睭內甜蜜像針威
blocks.spelling: gue̍h-tâi pinn tsîng-lîn siang siang tuì tuì ba̍k-tsiu lāi tinn-bi̍t tshiūnn tsiam ui

blocks.text: 咁是你已將約束放袂記
blocks.spelling: kam sī lí í tsiòng iok-sok pàng-buē-kì

blocks.text: 冷風像知我無人安慰　替阮哮歸暝
blocks.spelling: líng-hong tshiūnn tsai guá bô-lâng an-uì thuè gún hau kui-mî

blocks.text: 為按怎我攏袂清醒　到如今猶原放袂開
blocks.spelling: uî án-tsuánn guá lóng buē tshing-tshínn kàu lû-kim iu-guân pàng buē-khui

blocks.text: 一個人拉著感情線　行越遠越孤單
blocks.spelling: tsi̍t ê lâng giú-tio̍h kám-tsîng suànn kiânn lú hn̄g lú koo-tuann

blocks.text: 思念哪親像點袂著的番仔火
blocks.spelling: su-liām ná tshin-tshiūnn tiám buē-tio̍h ê huan-á-húe

blocks.text: 免等到風吹　早已經有魂無體
blocks.spelling: bián tán-kàu hong-tshue tsá í-king ū hûn bô thé

blocks.text: 對你的癡心　傷心
blocks.spelling: tuì lí ê tshi sim siong sim

blocks.text: 擱剩彼多　卡多嘛無人可體會
blocks.spelling: koh sīng hiah tsē kha̍h tsē mā bô-lâng ē thé-huē

blocks.text: 緣份哪親像點袂著的番仔火
blocks.spelling: iân hūn ná tshin-tshiūnn tiám buē-tio̍h ê huan-á-húe

blocks.text: 越點越心酸　越愛越袂凍做伙
blocks.spelling: lú tiám lú sim-sng lú ài lú buē-tàng tsò-hué

blocks.text: 若不是想你　想甲　無路可退
blocks.spelling: ná m̄ sī siūnn lí siūnn kā bô-lōo khó thuè

blocks.text: 也袂留給你有機會　傷阮徹底
blocks.spelling: iā buē lâu hōo lí ū ki-huē siong gún thiat-té
